// Programs from scenes/shaders/, copied by the course's listing
// tool. Do not edit.

// region: lambert
; Lambert diffuse: the vertex colour times how squarely the surface
; faces a fixed light, plus a little ambient so shadowed faces are
; not black. Normals are unit length (each face has one normal).
.in r g b nx ny nz                ; r0 r1 r2 = colour, r3 r4 r5 = normal
.const light 0.30305 0.80812 0.50508  ; unit vector towards the light
mul r6, r3, light.x
mad r6, r4, light.y, r6
mad r6, r5, light.z, r6           ; r6 = n . light
max r6, r6, 0                     ; a face turned away gets no light
mad r6, r6, 0.8, 0.2              ; 20% ambient, 80% diffuse
mul r0, r0, r6
mul r1, r1, r6
mul r2, r2, r6
out r0, r1, r2
// endregion: lambert

// region: lambert-glsl
// GLSL twin of lambert.asm, in the comparison page's function form:
// the page adds the #version line, highp precision and the varyings,
// and calls shade() with the interpolated colour, uv and normal.
// highp float is float32, so each line below rounds as the assembly
// does. One place may differ: a GPU may fuse a * b + c into one
// rounding where the assembly's mad rounds twice (a last-bit change,
// far below one 8-bit level).
const vec3 light = vec3(0.30305, 0.80812, 0.50508);

vec3 shade(vec3 color, vec2 uv, vec3 n) {
  float d = n.x * light.x;
  d = n.y * light.y + d;
  d = n.z * light.z + d;            // n . light, in the same order
  d = max(d, 0.0);
  d = d * 0.8 + 0.2;                // 20% ambient, 80% diffuse
  return color * d;
}
// endregion: lambert-glsl

// region: checker-branch
; A checker of 8 x 8 squares in (u, v), shaded with a branch: dark
; squares take the if side, light squares the else side. Pixels on
; either side of a square's edge disagree, so a warp that straddles
; an edge runs both sides.
.in u v r g b                     ; r0 = u, r1 = v, r2 r3 r4 = colour
mul r5, r0, 8
floor r5, r5                      ; column
mul r6, r1, 8
floor r6, r6                      ; row
add r5, r5, r6
mul r5, r5, 0.5
frac r5, r5                       ; 0.5 on odd squares, 0 on even
if r5
  mul r2, r2, 0.3                 ; dark square: a dim, cool copy
  mul r3, r3, 0.35
  mul r4, r4, 0.45
else
  mad r2, r2, 0.6, 0.4            ; light square: towards white
  mad r3, r3, 0.6, 0.4
  mad r4, r4, 0.6, 0.38
endif
out r2, r3, r4
// endregion: checker-branch

// region: coherent-branch
; A branch most warps agree on: a gold stripe over the last eighth of
; each unit of u. The condition changes only at the stripe's two
; edges, so nearly every 4 x 2 block is all inside or all outside and
; runs one side. The stripe side is long; the other is one line.
.in u v r g b                     ; r0 = u, r1 = v, r2 r3 r4 = colour
.const gold 1.0 0.78 0.3
frac r5, r0                       ; 0 to 1 across each unit of u
sge r6, r5, 0.875                 ; the last eighth is the stripe
if r6
  sub r7, r5, 0.9375              ; -0.0625 to 0.0625 across it
  mul r7, r7, 16                  ; -1 to 1
  mul r7, r7, r7
  sub r7, 1, r7                   ; 1 at the centre, 0 at the edges
  mul r8, r7, r7                  ; a sharper sheen
  sub r9, gold.r, r2
  mad r2, r9, r8, r2              ; colour + (gold - colour) * sheen
  sub r9, gold.g, r3
  mad r3, r9, r8, r3
  sub r9, gold.b, r4
  mad r4, r9, r8, r4
  mul r8, r8, r8
  mul r8, r8, r8                  ; a narrow glint on top
  mad r2, r8, 0.2, r2
  mad r3, r8, 0.2, r3
  mad r4, r8, 0.2, r4
  out r2, r3, r4
else
  out r2, r3, r4                  ; outside the stripe: the colour
endif
// endregion: coherent-branch

// region: textured
; A texture fetch times Lambert: colour x texel x light.
.in r g b u v nx ny nz            ; r0-r2 colour, r3 r4 uv, r5-r7 normal
.const light 0.30305 0.80812 0.50508  ; unit vector towards the light
tex r8, r3, r4, floor             ; r8 r9 r10 r11 = texel RGBA (nearest)
mul r12, r5, light.x
mad r12, r6, light.y, r12
mad r12, r7, light.z, r12         ; n . light
max r12, r12, 0
mad r12, r12, 0.8, 0.2            ; 20% ambient, 80% diffuse
mul r0, r0, r8
mul r1, r1, r9
mul r2, r2, r10
mul r0, r0, r12
mul r1, r1, r12
mul r2, r2, r12
out r0, r1, r2
// endregion: textured

// region: escape
; Escape count: iterate z = z * z + c from z = 0, with c from (u, v),
; until |z| reaches 2 or 40 turns have run. The grey level is the
; number of turns. Each lane leaves the loop after its own count.
.in u v                           ; r0 = u, r1 = v
mad r2, r0, 3, -2.2               ; c.x from -2.2 to 0.8
mad r3, r1, 2.4, -1.2             ; c.y from -1.2 to 1.2
mov r4, 0                         ; z.x
mov r5, 0                         ; z.y
mov r6, 0                         ; n, the turns run so far
loop
  mul r7, r4, r4                  ; z.x squared
  mul r8, r5, r5                  ; z.y squared
  add r9, r7, r8
  sge r10, r9, 4                  ; |z| >= 2
  sge r11, r6, 40                 ; or 40 turns already
  max r10, r10, r11
  break r10
  mul r9, r4, r5
  mad r5, r9, 2, r3               ; z.y = 2 z.x z.y + c.y
  sub r7, r7, r8
  add r4, r7, r2                  ; z.x = z.x^2 - z.y^2 + c.x
  add r6, r6, 1
endloop
mul r6, r6, 0.025                 ; n / 40
out r6, r6, r6
// endregion: escape
